lines.text: Reaching beyond the familiar

lines.text: O3XO was born from O3's recognition that AI requires a specialized approach, one that combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. The "XO" in our name draws inspiration from the exosphere, Earth's outermost atmospheric layer and symbol of the frontier beyond O3, the ozone layer that represents our core brand.
